title: agentic-commerce
description: MCP server for Boson Protocol — on-chain agentic commerce for physical & digital goods.
summary: MCP server for Boson Protocol — on-chain agentic commerce for physical & digital goods.
offersHint: MCP server for Boson Protocol — on-chain agentic commerce for physical & digital goods. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://mcp.bosonprotocol.io/mcp

toolsPreview.name: get_config_ids
toolsPreview.description: Returns all valid configId values for this server. Call first to discover which network/deployment to use. No auth required.

toolsPreview.name: get_funds
toolsPreview.description: Reads treasury fund balances for sellers and buyers from the Boson subgraph. Supports pagination/ordering/filtering. Read-only — signerAddress not required. Returns: array of { tokenAddress, availableAmount, accountId }.

toolsPreview.name: get_disputes
toolsPreview.description: Reads dispute records from the Boson subgraph. Supports pagination, ordering, and filtering by buyer/seller/state. Read-only. Returns: array of dispute entities with exchangeId, state, timeout.

toolsPreview.name: get_dispute_by_id
toolsPreview.description: Reads a single dispute by its ID (equals the exchangeId). Read-only. Returns: dispute entity with state, timeout, buyerPercent. Use get_disputes to search first.

toolsPreview.name: get_exchanges
toolsPreview.description: Reads exchange records (offer commitments) from the Boson subgraph. Filter by buyer/seller/state. Read-only. Returns: array of exchanges with offerId, state (Committed/Redeemed/Completed/Disputed/Cancelled/Revoked), and voucher details.

toolsPreview.name: get_offers
toolsPreview.description: Reads offer listings from the Boson subgraph. Supports pagination, ordering, and filtering (e.g. by sellerId). Read-only. Returns: array of offers with price, deposit, dates, and quantity.

toolsPreview.name: get_sellers
toolsPreview.description: Reads seller account entities from the Boson subgraph. Optionally includes related offers, exchanges, funds, and logs. Read-only. Returns: array of seller entities with addresses and metadataUri.

toolsPreview.name: get_dispute_resolvers
toolsPreview.description: Reads registered dispute resolver entities. Use this to find a valid disputeResolverId for create_offer. Read-only. Returns: array of resolvers with ID, fees, escalationResponsePeriod, and supported tokens.

toolsPreview.name: create_offer
toolsPreview.description: Creates a product offer. Caller must have a seller account (create_seller first). Prerequisite: store metadata first with store_product_v1_metadata or store_base_metadata to get metadataUri/metadataHash. All dates in milliseconds; amounts as strings in wei. Returns unsigned tx — sign locally with your wallet → send_signed_transaction, or executionMode='metaTx'.

toolsPreview.name: create_offer_with_condition
toolsPreview.description: Creates an offer gated by token-ownership (e.g. hold an ERC-721 to commit). Same prerequisites as create_offer plus a condition object specifying the gate token, method, and threshold. Returns unsigned transaction data.

toolsPreview.name: create_buyer
toolsPreview.description: Creates a buyer account for signerAddress. Required before a buyer can commit to seller-initiated offers for the first time. No prerequisites. Returns unsigned transaction data.

toolsPreview.name: sign_full_offer
toolsPreview.description: Generates EIP-712 typed data for a non-listed (private) offer that the offer creator must sign. Call before create_offer_and_commit or void_non_listed_offer. Returns: typed data structure — sign it locally with your wallet (EIP-712), then use the signature in the next step.

toolsPreview.name: create_offer_and_commit
toolsPreview.description: Atomically creates a private offer and commits a specific buyer in one transaction. Prerequisite: call sign_full_offer, sign the returned typed data locally with your wallet (EIP-712), and provide the signature here. Used for private/bilateral trades. Returns unsigned transaction data.

toolsPreview.name: create_offer_commit_and_redeem
toolsPreview.description: Atomically creates a private offer, commits a specific buyer, and immediately redeems the voucher in a single transaction via the OrchestrationHandler. Same prerequisites as create_offer_and_commit (sign_full_offer + EIP-712 signature). Use for instant-fulfilment private trades. Returns unsigned transaction data.

toolsPreview.name: void_offer
toolsPreview.description: Voids a listed offer so it can no longer be committed to. Caller must be the seller assistant. Existing exchanges are unaffected. Returns unsigned transaction data.

toolsPreview.name: void_non_listed_offer
toolsPreview.description: Voids a private (non-listed) offer before it is fulfilled. Prerequisite: call sign_full_offer and sign the returned typed data locally with your wallet (EIP-712) to obtain the signature. Returns unsigned transaction data.

toolsPreview.name: void_non_listed_offer_batch
toolsPreview.description: Voids multiple private offers atomically. Same prerequisite as void_non_listed_offer, but for an array of full offer objects. Returns unsigned transaction data.

toolsPreview.name: create_seller
toolsPreview.description: Creates a seller account on Boson Protocol. Required before creating any offers. signerAddress is automatically set as admin, assistant, and treasury. Provide seller metadata and royaltyPercentage. Returns unsigned transaction data.

toolsPreview.name: update_seller
toolsPreview.description: Updates an existing seller account. Caller must be the current seller admin (signerAddress). Use get_sellers_by_address to retrieve the seller id first. Returns unsigned transaction data.

toolsPreview.name: send_signed_transaction
toolsPreview.description: Broadcasts a signed raw Ethereum transaction to the network. signedTransaction must be 0x-prefixed RLP-encoded hex obtained from local wallet signing (e.g. ethers `wallet.signTransaction(tx)`). Returns: transaction hash, block number, and gas used.

toolsPreview.name: send_meta_transaction
toolsPreview.description: Relays a pre-signed meta-transaction via Biconomy so the user pays no gas. Requires sigR/sigS/sigV from a locally-signed EIP-712 payload. Use when the target operation requires metaTx relay. Returns: relay transaction data.

toolsPreview.name: send_native_meta_transaction
toolsPreview.description: Relays a native meta-transaction (EIP-712 signed function call) via Biconomy. Requires ABI-encoded function signature and sigR/sigS/sigV from a locally-signed EIP-712 payload. Returns: relay transaction data.

toolsPreview.name: send_forwarded_meta_transaction
toolsPreview.description: Relays a Biconomy forwarded meta-transaction (ERC-20 gas payment). Requires a complete ERC20ForwardRequest and domain separator signature. Returns: relay transaction data.

toolsPreview.name: withdraw_funds
toolsPreview.description: Withdraws funds from an entity's protocol treasury to the entity's treasury address. Sellers withdraw proceeds; buyers withdraw refunds. Caller must control the entity via signerAddress. Returns unsigned transaction data.

toolsPreview.name: deposit_funds
toolsPreview.description: Deposits ERC-20 or native tokens into an entity's protocol treasury (e.g. seller deposit). For ERC-20, call approve_exchange_token first. Returns unsigned transaction data.

toolsPreview.name: extend_dispute_timeout
toolsPreview.description: Extends the deadline of an active dispute. Dispute must be in 'Resolving' state. Either party can call this. Returns unsigned transaction data.

toolsPreview.name: expire_dispute
toolsPreview.description: Marks a dispute as expired after its resolution period passes. Permissionless — anyone can call. Exchange must be in 'Disputed' state past its timeout. Returns unsigned transaction data.

toolsPreview.name: expire_dispute_batch
toolsPreview.description: Marks multiple expired disputes in one transaction. All exchanges must be in 'Disputed' state past their respective timeouts. Permissionless. Returns unsigned transaction data.

toolsPreview.name: resolve_dispute
toolsPreview.description: Resolves a dispute by mutual agreement. Workflow: (1) create_dispute_resolution_proposal generates typed data, (2) both parties sign the typed data locally with their wallet (EIP-712), (3) either party submits sigR/sigS/sigV here. Returns unsigned transaction data.

toolsPreview.name: raise_dispute
toolsPreview.description: Raises a dispute on a redeemed exchange. Caller must be the buyer. Must be called within disputePeriodDurationInMS after redemption. Returns unsigned transaction data.

toolsPreview.name: retract_dispute
toolsPreview.description: Retracts a raised dispute, releasing seller deposit and restoring completion flow. Caller must be the buyer who raised it. Returns unsigned transaction data.

toolsPreview.name: escalate_dispute
toolsPreview.description: Escalates a stale dispute to the third-party dispute resolver. Caller must be the buyer. Resolver's escalation fee must be covered. Returns unsigned transaction data.

toolsPreview.name: decide_dispute
toolsPreview.description: Decides an escalated dispute. Caller must be the dispute resolver assigned to the offer's disputeResolverId. Specify buyerPercent in basis points (0=all to seller, 10000=all to buyer). Returns unsigned transaction data.

toolsPreview.name: refuse_escalated_dispute
toolsPreview.description: Dispute resolver refuses to decide an escalated dispute. Returns the escalation fee to the buyer and resets dispute to 'Resolving' state. Returns unsigned transaction data.

toolsPreview.name: expire_escalated_dispute
toolsPreview.description: Expires an escalated dispute once the resolver's response period passes without a decision. Permissionless — anyone can call. Returns unsigned transaction data.

toolsPreview.name: create_dispute_resolution_proposal
toolsPreview.description: Generates EIP-712 typed data for a mutual dispute resolution proposal. Both buyer and seller must sign the same buyerPercentBasisPoints value locally with their wallet (EIP-712) before calling resolve_dispute. Returns: typed data structure (domain, types, message).

toolsPreview.name: revoke_voucher
toolsPreview.description: Revokes a committed (not yet redeemed) voucher on behalf of the seller, returning funds to the buyer. Caller must be the seller assistant. Returns unsigned transaction data.

toolsPreview.name: approve_exchange_token
toolsPreview.description: Grants ERC-20 allowance to the Boson Protocol contract. Must be called before commit_to_offer or deposit_funds when using non-native exchange tokens. Returns unsigned transaction data.

toolsPreview.name: sign_receive_with_erc3009_authorization
toolsPreview.description: Generates EIP-712 typed data for an ERC-3009 ReceiveWithAuthorization (e.g. USDC). Authorizes the spender (default: protocol diamond) to pull `value` from signerAddress between validAfter and validBefore. Sign locally with your wallet (EIP-712); use the resulting signature + nonce to build a TransferAuthorization { strategy: 'ERC3009' } for a meta-tx flow. Returns: typed data structure.

toolsPreview.name: sign_receive_with_erc2612_permit
toolsPreview.description: Generates EIP-712 typed data for an EIP-2612 Permit. Authorizes the spender (default: protocol diamond) to pull `value` from signerAddress until `deadline`. Sign locally with your wallet (EIP-712); use the resulting signature to build a TransferAuthorization { strategy: 'EIP2612' } for a meta-tx flow. Returns: typed data structure.

toolsPreview.name: sign_receive_with_permit2
toolsPreview.description: Generates EIP-712 typed data for a Uniswap Permit2 PermitTransferFrom. Authorizes the spender (default: protocol diamond) to pull `value` from signerAddress until `deadline`. permit2Address defaults to contracts.permit2 from SDK config; permit2Nonce defaults to a random uint256. Sign locally with your wallet (EIP-712); use the result to build a TransferAuthorization { strategy: 'Permit2' } for a meta-tx flow. Returns: typed data structure.

toolsPreview.name: sign_receive_with_dai_permit
toolsPreview.description: Generates EIP-712 typed data for a DAI-style Permit. Authorizes the spender (default: protocol diamond) to pull DAI-style tokens from signerAddress until `expiry`. Sign locally with your wallet (EIP-712); use the result to build a TransferAuthorization { strategy: 'DAIPermit' } for a meta-tx flow. Returns: typed data structure.

toolsPreview.name: commit_to_offer
toolsPreview.description: Commits to an offer, creating an exchange and minting a voucher NFT. Caller is the buyer (signerAddress) unless 'buyer' param is set. For ERC-20 offers, call approve_exchange_token first. Returns unsigned transaction data.

toolsPreview.name: commit_to_conditional_offer
toolsPreview.description: Commits to a token-gated (conditional) offer using a specific gating tokenId. Caller (signerAddress) must hold the gating token specified by the offer's condition. Use this instead of commit_to_offer for offers created via create_offer_with_condition. Returns unsigned transaction data.

toolsPreview.name: commit_to_offer_and_redeem_voucher
toolsPreview.description: Atomically commits to an offer and immediately redeems the voucher in a single transaction via the OrchestrationHandler. Buyer (signerAddress) must already hold any required ERC-20 allowance (approve_exchange_token). Skips voucher transferability and starts the dispute period clock immediately. Returns unsigned transaction data.

toolsPreview.name: commit_to_conditional_offer_and_redeem_voucher
toolsPreview.description: Atomically commits to a token-gated (conditional) offer using a specific gating tokenId and immediately redeems the voucher in a single transaction. Buyer must hold the gating token. Returns unsigned transaction data.

toolsPreview.name: commit_to_buyer_offer
toolsPreview.description: Fulfils a buyer-initiated offer (creator='BUYER') by the seller. Caller must be the seller. Provide matching collateral. Returns unsigned transaction data.

toolsPreview.name: cancel_voucher
toolsPreview.description: Cancels a committed voucher. Caller must be the buyer (voucher holder). Buyer forfeits buyerCancellationPenalty; remainder is refunded. Returns unsigned transaction data.

toolsPreview.name: redeem_voucher
toolsPreview.description: Redeems a voucher, signalling physical receipt of goods and starting the dispute period clock. Caller must be the buyer. After redemption, buyer has disputePeriodDurationInMS to raise a dispute. Returns unsigned transaction data.

toolsPreview.name: complete_exchange
toolsPreview.description: Completes an exchange after the dispute period expires, releasing funds to the seller. Can be called by seller after dispute period or by buyer at any time post-redemption. Returns unsigned transaction data.

toolsPreview.name: get_sellers_by_address
toolsPreview.description: Reads seller entities associated with a specific Ethereum address. Use this to check if signerAddress already has a seller account before calling create_seller. Read-only. Returns: array of seller entities.

toolsPreview.name: get_all_products_with_not_voided_variants
toolsPreview.description: Reads product groupings with at least one non-voided variant from the Boson subgraph. Useful for storefront displays. Supports pagination and ordering. Read-only.

toolsPreview.name: search_products
toolsPreview.description: Searches products in the Boson subgraph by keywords matched against title, description, brand, category, and tags. Supports pagination, ordering, filtering, and an includeInvalidOffers flag (default false = only products with currently-valid offers). Read-only. Returns: array of product search result fragments.

toolsPreview.name: validate_metadata
toolsPreview.description: Validates a metadata object against the Boson Protocol schema (PRODUCT_V1, BUNDLE, BASE, etc.) without storing it. Use before store_*_metadata to catch errors early. Read-only. Returns: validation result with any errors.

toolsPreview.name: store_product_v1_metadata
toolsPreview.description: Stores a ProductV1 metadata object to IPFS. Call before create_offer to get metadataUri and metadataHash. Returns: { metadataUri: 'ipfs://...', metadataHash: '0x...' }.

toolsPreview.name: store_bundle_metadata
toolsPreview.description: Stores a Bundle metadata object to IPFS. Prerequisite: call store_bundle_item_product_v1_metadata and/or store_bundle_item_nft_metadata first; include their returned URLs in the items array. Returns: { metadataUri, metadataHash }.

toolsPreview.name: store_base_metadata
toolsPreview.description: Stores a Base metadata object to IPFS. Use for simple offers that don't require ProductV1 or Bundle structure. Returns: { metadataUri, metadataHash } for use in create_offer.

toolsPreview.name: render_contractual_agreement
toolsPreview.description: Renders the legal contractual agreement text/HTML for an offer using its offer data and metadata. Use to preview or store the agreement. Returns: rendered agreement string.

toolsPreview.name: store_bundle_item_product_v1_metadata
toolsPreview.description: Stores a single ProductV1 bundle item's metadata to IPFS. Call once per physical product in a bundle before store_bundle_metadata. Returns: { url: 'ipfs://...' } to include in the items array.

toolsPreview.name: store_bundle_item_nft_metadata
toolsPreview.description: Stores a single NFT bundle item's metadata to IPFS. Call once per NFT component in a bundle before store_bundle_metadata. Returns: { url: 'ipfs://...' } to include in the items array.

toolsPreview.name: register_agent
toolsPreview.description: Registers a dACP agent with this MCP server instance, associating its Ethereum identities and roles. The signature proves control of each signerAddress. Server-local state — no configId/signerAddress context needed. Returns: registration confirmation.

toolsPreview.name: get_registered_agents
toolsPreview.description: Returns all dACP agents registered with this MCP server instance, with their associated protocol entities and roles. No auth required.

toolsPreview.name: get_supported_tokens
toolsPreview.description: Returns ERC-20 tokens accepted as exchange tokens on the given configId deployment. Use returned addresses in exchangeTokenAddress fields of create_offer. Read-only. Returns: array of { address, name, symbol, decimals }.
